Central.reason: Central Line: Minor delays while we fix a signal failure at Snaresbrook.

Circle.reason: Circle Line: Minor delays due to a collapsed drain on the track at Baker Street.

Elizabeth line.reason: Minor delays between Hayes & Harlington and Reading due to vandalism to railway equipment in the Paddington area. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Metropolitan.reason: Metropolitan Line: No service between Baker Street and Aldgate and MINOR DELAYS on the rest of the line due to a collapsed drain on the track at Baker Street. Tickets are being accepted on London Buses, Chiltern Railway and Thameslink.

Piccadilly.reason: Piccadilly Line: Minor delays between Acton Town and Uxbridge due to an earlier animal on the track. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.
